game_concept: A adventure race set in Frost Peaks – Avalanche Slope, a slope primed for avalanche: the rescue climber must handle ice hawks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Phrase Slicer: Slice strings to cut messages into exactly the needed pieces.
theme: Frost Peaks – Avalanche Slope: a slope primed for avalanche
core_gameplay_loop: In Avalanche Slope, repeat each round: Slice strings to cut messages into exactly the needed pieces. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the rescue climber ahead. Then check the phrase_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the rescue sled by solving code steps involving phrase_ok that move the rescue climber forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the rescue sled first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 9 (extended tier): Phrase Slicer
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Phrase Slicer' (Week 8 slot 2), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Avalanche Slope'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how phrase_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ice hawks in Avalanche Slope.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
